faq.pageDescription: Frequently asked questions about pet travel and using AirPets
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to popular questions about the site and pet transportation

whatIsAirPets.question: What is AirPets?
whatIsAirPets.answer: AirPets is a free directory for pet transportation by air. We collect and organize information about pet travel rules of various airlines to help you plan trips with your beloved pets.

isFree.question: Is the site free to use?
isFree.answer: Yes, AirPets is completely free. We don't charge for access to information and don't require registration.

dataSource.question: Where does the data come from?
dataSource.answer: We collect information from official airline websites and regularly update it. Each airline card contains a link to the official rules.

dataAccuracy.question: How accurate is the data?
dataAccuracy.answer: We strive to keep the data up-to-date, but airlines may change their rules. We recommend always checking the information on the airline's official website before purchasing a ticket.

howToSearch.question: How do I find the airline I need?
howToSearch.answer: Use the search bar to enter the airline name. You can also apply filters by transportation method: In Cabin, In Baggage, Cargo.

whatAreBadges.question: What do Cabin/Baggage/Cargo badges mean?
whatAreBadges.answer:
Badges show available transportation methods:
• Cabin (✈️) — pet flies with you in the cabin
• Baggage (🧳) — pet in the baggage compartment
• Cargo (📦) — separate cargo transportation

Hover over the badge to see detailed conditions.

howToSwitchLanguage.question: How do I switch language?
howToSwitchLanguage.answer: Click the RU/EN button in the top right corner. The site supports Russian and English languages.

airlineNotFound.question: Can't find my airline, what should I do?
airlineNotFound.answer: Contact us through the feedback form at the bottom of the page. Specify the airline name and we'll try to add it to the database.

canPrint.question: Can I print the information?
canPrint.answer: Yes, open the airline's page ("View Details" button) and use your browser's print function (Ctrl+P).

whatIsCabin.question: What is "In Cabin" transportation?
whatIsCabin.answer: This is when your pet flies with you in the passenger cabin in a special carrier under the front seat. Usually allowed for small animals (up to 8 kg including carrier).

whatIsBaggage.question: What is "In Baggage" transportation?
whatIsBaggage.answer: The animal is transported in the baggage compartment in a special container. Suitable for medium and large animals that don't fit in the cabin.

whatIsCargo.question: What is "Cargo" transportation?
whatIsCargo.answer: This is cargo transportation for large animals or multiple pets. Booked separately from the passenger ticket through the airline's cargo service.

carrierSize.question: What does "Carrier Size" mean?
carrierSize.answer: These are the maximum dimensions of the carrier/container for the animal in the format: length × width × height (e.g., 55×40×25 cm). The carrier must fit under the front seat.

needToPay.question: Do I need to pay for pet transportation?
needToPay.answer: Yes, most airlines charge an additional fee for pet transportation. Check the cost and payment rules when booking a ticket or on the airline's website.

whatDocuments.question: What documents are needed for pet transportation?
whatDocuments.answer:
Usually required:
• Veterinary passport
• Health certificate (form №1)
• Vaccination certificate (especially rabies)
• For international flights: international veterinary certificate

Requirements may differ depending on the destination country.

howToPrepare.question: How to prepare a pet for flight?
howToPrepare.answer:
Recommendations:
• Get your pet used to the carrier in advance
• Don't feed 3-4 hours before the flight
• Bring water and absorbent pad
• Attach a tag with contacts to the carrier
• Consult with a vet about sedatives

canBringMultiple.question: Can I fly with multiple pets?
canBringMultiple.answer: Rules vary by airline. Usually 1 animal per passenger is allowed in the cabin. For multiple pets, cargo transportation may be required. Check with the airline.

wrongData.question: I found inaccurate data, what should I do?
wrongData.answer: Contact us through the feedback form, specifying the airline name and what information is incorrect. We'll verify and update the data.

addAirline.question: I want to add an airline to the database
addAirline.answer: Great! Contact us through the feedback form, specify the airline name and link to official pet travel rules. We'll add it soon.

siteIssue.question: I have a problem with the site
siteIssue.answer: Describe the problem in the feedback form: what exactly doesn't work, which browser you're using, attach a screenshot if possible. We'll try to help.

contactTeam.question: How to contact the AirPets team?
contactTeam.answer: Use the feedback form at the bottom of the main page. We respond to all messages within 1-2 business days.
